location.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Illinois, represented in the General Assembly:

date.provenance: Section 99. Effective date. This Act takes effect upon becoming law.

pfas_definition.provenance:
Section 5. The Environmental Protection Act is amended by adding Section 22.62 as follows:

Sec. 22.62. TRI-PFAS; incineration.

(b) No person shall dispose of any TRI-PFAS by incineration, including, but not limited to, aqueous film-forming foam that contains TRI-PFAS.
